dialogues.jp: 「お、あそこに座っているのは、ことりだな」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, Kotori's sitting over there."
dialogues.text: "Ohh, Kotori's sitting over there."

dialogues.jp:
廊下の窓から、中庭を見下ろす。ことりがベン
チに座っていた。
dialogues.en:
From a corridor window, I had a great view of the courtyard.
I could see Kotori sitting on a bench.
dialogues.text:
From a corridor window, I had a great view of the courtyard.
I could see Kotori sitting on a bench.

dialogues.jp: 「一人か。……ちょっと行ってみよう」
dialogues.en: "She's alone. ...Guess I'd go over."
dialogues.text: "She's alone. ...Guess I'd go over."

dialogues.jp: 「だ〜れだ」
dialogues.en: "Guess who~"
dialogues.text: "Guess who~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……誰ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Who is it?"
dialogues.text: "...Who is it?"

dialogues.jp:
まるっきりあっさりと返され、俺は敗北感を覚
えつつ手を離した。
dialogues.en:
With such a completely straight reply, I defeatedly removed
my hands from her eyes.
dialogues.text:
With such a completely straight reply, I defeatedly removed
my hands from her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、朝倉君。こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……素で返されると、さすがに切ないものが
　あるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...Such a frank reply wounded me deeply, I'd have you
know!"
dialogues.text:
"...Such a frank reply wounded me deeply, I'd have you
know!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どんな風に返せばいいんでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "How should I have replied, then?"
dialogues.text: "How should I have replied, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだな。ダーリンでしょとか、このウジ虫
　とか」
dialogues.en: "Well, maybe darling, or you worm!..."
dialogues.text: "Well, maybe darling, or you worm!..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「両極端ですよ……」
dialogues.en: "Quite an extreme person aren't you..."
dialogues.text: "Quite an extreme person aren't you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「隣、いい？」
dialogues.en: "May I sit?"
dialogues.text: "May I sit?"

dialogues.jp:
ベンチの空いている部分を指さす。ことりはこ
くんとうなずいた。
dialogues.en:
I point to the empty space next to her on the bench. Kotori
gave her assent with a nod.
dialogues.text:
I point to the empty space next to her on the bench. Kotori
gave her assent with a nod.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、膝の上にハンカチを敷いて、その上
に小さな弁当箱を載せている。
dialogues.en:
Kotori laid out a small handkerchief on her lap, and placed
her lunchbox on it.
dialogues.text:
Kotori laid out a small handkerchief on her lap, and placed
her lunchbox on it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、ああいうのは、女の子がするもの
　じゃないんですか」
dialogues.en: "Generally, isn't what you said done only by girls?"
dialogues.text: "Generally, isn't what you said done only by girls?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What about?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だから、だ〜れだ、です」
dialogues.en: "The "Guess who~" part, I mean."
dialogues.text: "The "Guess who~" part, I mean."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、まぁ、そうなのかなあ……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, well, about that..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, well, about that..."

dialogues.jp: パンの袋を開け、かぶりつきながら首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: I tilted my head in thought, while opening my bread packet.
dialogues.text: I tilted my head in thought, while opening my bread packet.

dialogues.jp: 「何にしろ、経験がないから分からんな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I can't say I've ever done that or had that happen to
me, so I don't know."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I can't say I've ever done that or had that happen to
me, so I don't know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 意外そうな声音に、俺はことりに顔を向けた。
dialogues.en:
From her surprising tone of voice, I turned to look in her
direction.
dialogues.text:
From her surprising tone of voice, I turned to look in her
direction.

dialogues.jp: 「そうだけど？」
dialogues.en: "You don't think so?"
dialogues.text: "You don't think so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、最近、学園じゃ有名ですよ。ほら、あ
　の女の子……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, recently, you've been pretty famous in school,
because of that girl..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, recently, you've been pretty famous in school,
because of that girl..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりがツインテールを示すように、頭に両手
をのせて下に流す。
dialogues.en:
Kotori placed her hands on either side of her head, making
the shape of two ponytails from it.
dialogues.text:
Kotori placed her hands on either side of her head, making
the shape of two ponytails from it.

dialogues.jp: 「……芳乃さくら」
dialogues.en: "...Yoshino Sakura."
dialogues.text: "...Yoshino Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうです。そう」
dialogues.en: "Yes, her!"
dialogues.text: "Yes, her!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さくら、ねえ……」
dialogues.en: "Sakura, huh..."
dialogues.text: "Sakura, huh..."

dialogues.jp: まぁ、学園の連中は奴の実体を知らないしな。
dialogues.en:
Well, the rest of the school doesn't really know the truth
about her, and probably finds it amusing.
dialogues.text:
Well, the rest of the school doesn't really know the truth
about her, and probably finds it amusing.

dialogues.jp:
俺の見る限り、あの珍獣のような外見に、こと
ごとく惑わされているみたいだが……。
dialogues.en:
Why she still has the same body from 6 years ago is still a
puzzle to me...
dialogues.text:
Why she still has the same body from 6 years ago is still a
puzzle to me...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねえ、ねえ、朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
ひそひそと声をひそめてくる。俺は耳を近づけ
た。
dialogues.en:
I rose my eyebrows as Kotori lowered her voice to a whisper.
I caught the hint, and brought my ear closer.
dialogues.text:
I rose my eyebrows as Kotori lowered her voice to a whisper.
I caught the hint, and brought my ear closer.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「実際のところ、どうなんですか？　芳乃さん
　とは」
dialogues.en: "What do you really think of her? Yoshino-san, that is."
dialogues.text: "What do you really think of her? Yoshino-san, that is."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「さくらかぁ……」
dialogues.en: "About Sakura..."
dialogues.text: "About Sakura..."

dialogues.jp: 呟いた時だった。
dialogues.en: Right after I muttered that,
dialogues.text: Right after I muttered that,

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それ、オレも聞きたいな」
dialogues.en: "I want to hear the answer too."
dialogues.text: "I want to hear the answer too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、工藤君」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kudou-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kudou-kun."

dialogues.jp:
工藤が俺の前に立って、にこりと爽やかな笑顔
を浮かべていた。
dialogues.en: Kudou stood in front of me, grinning widely.
dialogues.text: Kudou stood in front of me, grinning widely.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、ことり。隣いいかな？」
dialogues.en: "Hey Kotori. Mind if I sit down?"
dialogues.text: "Hey Kotori. Mind if I sit down?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞどうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Go ahead!"
dialogues.text: "Go ahead!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……あ、でも、そこだとちょっと冷えるから、
　朝倉君、少しずれてもらえますか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Ah, but this side's a little cold... Asakura-kun, can
you shift over here a little?"
dialogues.text:
"...Ah, but this side's a little cold... Asakura-kun, can
you shift over here a little?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ」
dialogues.en: "Uh? O, okay."
dialogues.text: "Uh? O, okay."

dialogues.jp:
俺が横にずれると、ことりも少しずれて、こと
りを挟んで俺と反対側に工藤が腰掛ける。
dialogues.en:
I shifted a bit closer to Kotori, and Kudou sat on my other
side to complete the "trap".
dialogues.text:
I shifted a bit closer to Kotori, and Kudou sat on my other
side to complete the "trap".

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thanks."
dialogues.text: "Thanks."

dialogues.jp:
ただ腰掛けるだけの動作なのに爽やかで、周囲
にキラキラと｛まぶ／眩｝しい何かを生み出していた。
dialogues.en:
He sat down brightly, then cheerfully looked around as if
life was springing up all around him.
dialogues.text:
He sat down brightly, then cheerfully looked around as if
life was springing up all around him.

dialogues.jp: どう間違ったとしても、俺にはできない芸風だ。
dialogues.en: Definitely not like what I usually do.
dialogues.text: Definitely not like what I usually do.

dialogues.jp: 俺が見ていると、工藤が小首を傾げた。
dialogues.en: At my stare, Kudou titled his head.
dialogues.text: At my stare, Kudou titled his head.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　オレの顔に何かついてるかな？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Is there something on my face?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? Is there something on my face?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、目がふたつに鼻がひとつ、ついでに唇
　もついてるな」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, just making sure that you have two eyes, a nose, and a
mouth."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, just making sure that you have two eyes, a nose, and a
mouth."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「よかった。それがついてなかったら、今ごろ
　大騒ぎしてるところだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Thank goodness, I don't know what I'd ever do without
them."
dialogues.text:
"Thank goodness, I don't know what I'd ever do without
them."

dialogues.jp: さらりと切り返せる辺りもポイントが高い。
dialogues.en: A cutting reply like that would score a lot of points.
dialogues.text: A cutting reply like that would score a lot of points.

dialogues.jp: ……って何のポイントだ。
dialogues.en: ...Bleh, what am I talking about.
dialogues.text: ...Bleh, what am I talking about.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「で、朝倉。いい加減、はぐらかさないで教え
　てくれよ」
dialogues.en: "So, Asakura. Tell us your answer already."
dialogues.text: "So, Asakura. Tell us your answer already."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「別に、はぐらかしているつもりはないんだが
　……」
dialogues.en: "I wouldn't say I really feel anything special for her..."
dialogues.text: "I wouldn't say I really feel anything special for her..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「奴はただの幼なじみだよ」
dialogues.en: "She's just a normal childhood friend."
dialogues.text: "She's just a normal childhood friend."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、ただの、と言い切っていいのかは分から
　ないけど。何年も会ってなかったし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I wouldn't say normal either... it's been so many
years since I last saw her, disregarding recently."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I wouldn't say normal either... it's been so many
years since I last saw her, disregarding recently."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「確か……外国に行ってたんだよな？」
dialogues.en: "I see... she went overseas, didn't she?"
dialogues.text: "I see... she went overseas, didn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「遠い土地で、何年間もずっと想い続けていた
　のか……凄いなあ」
dialogues.en:
"From a distant land, no matter how many years pass, the
feelings still remain... that's so wonderful!"
dialogues.text:
"From a distant land, no matter how many years pass, the
feelings still remain... that's so wonderful!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「それだけの間想い続けることができるのって、
　ただそれだけですごい力だよな」
dialogues.en:
"To have kept those feelings all this time is just a
testament to how strong they are."
dialogues.text:
"To have kept those feelings all this time is just a
testament to how strong they are."

dialogues.jp: ふたりが妙にしみじみと呟く。
dialogues.en: The two of them started talking brightly.
dialogues.text: The two of them started talking brightly.

dialogues.jp:
思わずむせる。ことりが焦らず急がず、自分が
飲んでいた缶ジュースを差し出してくれた。
dialogues.en:
I choked on my food at their comments. Kotori, sensing the
situation, quickly gave me her drink to wash it down.
dialogues.text:
I choked on my food at their comments. Kotori, sensing the
situation, quickly gave me her drink to wash it down.

dialogues.jp: 「……ありがと」
dialogues.en: "...Thanks."
dialogues.text: "...Thanks."

dialogues.jp: 一息ついて、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I take a deep breath, and start talking again.
dialogues.text: I take a deep breath, and start talking again.

dialogues.jp:
「……ふたりして変な事言うなよ。もし牛乳を
　飲んでる時だったら、鼻から垂れてるところ
　だぞ」
dialogues.en:
"...Stop saying such weird things, you two. If I was
drinking milk, it'd probably have been coming out of my
nose."
dialogues.text:
"...Stop saying such weird things, you two. If I was
drinking milk, it'd probably have been coming out of my
nose."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やけにピンポイントですね……」
dialogues.en: "Bullseye, it seems..."
dialogues.text: "Bullseye, it seems..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、変な事じゃありませんよ。ね？」
dialogues.en: "But it's not something weird anyway. Right?'
dialogues.text: "But it's not something weird anyway. Right?'

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Right."
dialogues.text: "Right."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだよ？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だって……」
dialogues.en: "Well..."
dialogues.text: "Well..."

dialogues.jp:
とっておきといった感じの笑顔を、ことりは浮
かべた。
dialogues.en: Kotori had a knowing smile on her face.
dialogues.text: Kotori had a knowing smile on her face.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「芳乃さん、好き好き光線出しているって話じゃ
　ないですか」
dialogues.en: "Because she likes you a lot, doesn't she?"
dialogues.text: "Because she likes you a lot, doesn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ぐあぁ……。それも、噂になってるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Gwah.... Isn't that just a rumour?"
dialogues.text: "Gwah.... Isn't that just a rumour?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「気づいてないのは得てして本人だけっていう
　パターンだね。けっこうスゴイ噂だよ」
dialogues.en:
"If even the subject herself is talking about it, I don't
think anyone can call it a rumour."
dialogues.text:
"If even the subject herself is talking about it, I don't
think anyone can call it a rumour."

dialogues.jp: 声を出さずに工藤が笑う。
dialogues.en: Kudou laughed a bit while throwing his 2 cents in.
dialogues.text: Kudou laughed a bit while throwing his 2 cents in.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、俺を指してヒソヒソ何か言ってるなとは
思っていたが……。
dialogues.en:
Now that I think about it, there have been people pointing
at me and whispering recently...
dialogues.text:
Now that I think about it, there have been people pointing
at me and whispering recently...

dialogues.jp: まさかそんなことになってるとは。
dialogues.en: Don't tell me it's because of that.
dialogues.text: Don't tell me it's because of that.

dialogues.jp:
なんて言うか、それって俺の恋路の障害物以外
の何物でもないんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en:
Is she trying to be an obstacle in my path to love or
something?
dialogues.text:
Is she trying to be an obstacle in my path to love or
something?

dialogues.jp:
くそ……さくらの奴め。後で、奥歯がたがたい
わせちゃる。
dialogues.en:
Damnit... that idiot. She better watch out next time I see
her...
dialogues.text:
Damnit... that idiot. She better watch out next time I see
her...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's okay!"
dialogues.text: "It's okay!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? What is?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? What is?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、もし、朝倉君の事が好きな女の子が
　居たとしたら……」
dialogues.en: I mean, if there's a girl who really likes you..."
dialogues.text: I mean, if there's a girl who really likes you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「芳乃さんにも、誰にも、有無を言わせないく
　らいの告白をするんじゃないかなって思うん
　です」
dialogues.en:
"Whether it's Yoshino-san or someone else, I don't think
she'd be one to not confess and just hide it in forever."
dialogues.text:
"Whether it's Yoshino-san or someone else, I don't think
she'd be one to not confess and just hide it in forever."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、確かに、さくらを黙らせるとなったら、
　それ相応の行動が必要だろうな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, her character pretty much ensures that she never
shuts up as well."
dialogues.text:
"Well, her character pretty much ensures that she never
shuts up as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「彼女以上にずっと朝倉と一緒にいるとか」
dialogues.en: "She'd definitely only confess together with you."
dialogues.text: "She'd definitely only confess together with you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「学園の全学生の前で告白してみるとか」
dialogues.en: "She'd confess in front of the whole school, I bet."
dialogues.text: "She'd confess in front of the whole school, I bet."

dialogues.jp: 工藤とことり、二人の声はほとんど同時だった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou and Kotori both offered their opinions at the same
time.
dialogues.text:
Kudou and Kotori both offered their opinions at the same
time.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君はどっちだと思います？」
dialogues.en: "What do you think, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "What do you think, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私と工藤君と、どっちの行動がいいと思いま
　す？」
dialogues.en: "Which of what Kudou and I said would you prefer?"
dialogues.text: "Which of what Kudou and I said would you prefer?"

dialogues.jp: それはだね……
dialogues.en: That would be...
dialogues.text: That would be...

dialogues.jp: ◆告白の仕方◆
dialogues.en: ◆Confessions About Confessions◆
dialogues.text: ◆Confessions About Confessions◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりと昼食を一緒していると、そこへ工藤も
現れて、俺とさくらの関係を尋ねられる。
dialogues.en:
Whiel eating lunch together with Kotori, Kudou and her
ambushed me with questions about Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Whiel eating lunch together with Kotori, Kudou and her
ambushed me with questions about Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
幼なじみだと言うと、それにしてはラブラブ光
線がすごいとか何とかいう話になって。
dialogues.en:
I tried to say that she's just a childhood friend, but the
love-love sparks didn't fade from their eyes.
dialogues.text:
I tried to say that she's just a childhood friend, but the
love-love sparks didn't fade from their eyes.

dialogues.jp:
さくらを黙らせるにはどうしたらいいのかとい
うことになった。
dialogues.en:
Then somehow the subject turned into what kind of confession
I'd be most receptive to.
dialogues.text:
Then somehow the subject turned into what kind of confession
I'd be most receptive to.

dialogues.jp:
工藤の『さくら以上にずっと朝倉と一緒にいる』
説と、ことりの『学園の全学生の前で告白して
みる』説とで、俺は選択を迫られた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou suggested one where the girl would do so only with me,
and Kotori suggested that the girl should do so in front of
the whole school, and threw me the gauntlet to choose.
dialogues.text:
Kudou suggested one where the girl would do so only with me,
and Kotori suggested that the girl should do so in front of
the whole school, and threw me the gauntlet to choose.
